acquisitionTimeState.detail: The benchmark scene carries no acquisition timestamp or sensor identifier, so this detection cannot be placed on a timeline and no drift can be computed from it.

probabilityRaster.note: Quantized from float32 to 8 bits for browser rendering. Polygons and reported metrics derive from the full-precision raster.

sarImagery.note: Display stretch only. Detection ran on calibrated float values, not on this 8-bit rendering.

groundTruth.note: Computed in this build from the frozen mask against the dataset ground truth. Development-split scene; the Part III evaluation set remains sealed.

observedPolygon.note: Model-derived geometry. This is a segmentation output, not an independently verified observation of oil.

interpretation: possible oil / oil-like SAR signature; not a confirmation of petroleum chemistry, type, thickness, volume or legality
